answer: In a PoA attestation graph, trust propagates through bounded-length random walks, so an identity’s influence is limited by reachable, independently attested mass rather than self-created links. A sybil island can amplify internal agreement, but its sparse external cut has low conductance, sharply limiting probability flow into honest regions. Thus min-cut transitivity bounds the cluster’s aggregate voting weight; honest attestations remain the stronger signal, like a falcon tracing only connected paths.
